This is sample content for checking Help. It is not the SpentIt manual.

# What this sample shows

SpentIt brings transactions together so you can see where money went. This page is only a sample of how Help will read.

The dates and amounts here use year-month-day dates and a comma for thousands, such as 2026-01-15 and 1,234.56. Your file shows the date order and amount grouping saved for that file.

![Blue sample mark](../images/sample-mark.png)

*A blue rectangle used to check pictures in Help. It is not a bank screen.*
